name: laziness
quote: Nah, I don't feel like it.
description: Avoiding an action due to the extra effort involved or the type of effort involved.

variations.name: physical laziness
variations.description: Avoiding physical actions perceived as boring or troublesome.

variations.name: mental laziness
variations.description: Avoiding mental effort perceived as boring or troublesome.

variations.name: social laziness
variations.description: Avoiding social ettiquette perceived as boring or troublesome.
examples: I don't want to write a thank-you note to gramma... can I just call her?

commentaries.quote: Not all 'laziness' is bad. Wisdom is about being right more often than not about what actions are best in which context.

conditions: Avoiding an action due to the extra effort involved being considered not worthwhile.
